Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 208, "heading": "VII STRATÉGIE ET TACTIQUE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u208-r0062", "target": "— Это что такое? — крикнул отец.", "source_sha256": "b975c6317e9a682aa8bb8a469947bcb1c1d1e88ab576d9e3da9656144f7159d5", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u208-r0062", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "8ca745d481137c500d205f123877a72fdae1ef22ae3bf655fc8e89b803a1b2a4"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u208-r0063", "target": "Младшая дочь, не выходя из тени, где она притаилась, показала окровавленный кулак. Разбивая стекло, она поранилась; она ушла к постели матери и плакала молча.", "source_sha256": "b441e2c0589950a32dc13f1473894b8e3636e0a40951c84d1e77c4d618681b2d", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u208-r0063", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "945125fce27407076541ee62ae3ca13ce06fcd9419c762f2240132f708ef4464"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 3, "book": 8, "chapter": 7, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u208-r0064", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ce fut le tour de la mère de se dresser et de crier :", "sha256": "93b6c11208a198f9cf8fcc78662acec1546e9ba2909197e321f192ae7d55c4d5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0065", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu vois bien les bêtises que tu fais ! en cassant ton carreau, elle s’est coupée !", "sha256": "cebbdece0df170a33296351da4bde05c686e555b2ed58b480db37e79ca83dcee", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0066", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tant mieux ! dit l’homme, c’était prévu.", "sha256": "4f3f77604a4aceafffb41ec240cd8a1947fb1681e38a000a3bd6071d5d546402", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0067", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment ? tant mieux ? reprit la femme.", "sha256": "ee4d66ebf631a1277f86c4cffd13d52d122fa6a5b0199be25319ed039cedf279", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0068", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Paix ! répliqua le père, je supprime la liberté de la presse.", "sha256": "0e2a12d736083ce3cf321987663a9e4aa171cf0fc2e3296e9b7606dac24e05b7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0069", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis, déchirant la chemise de femme qu’il avait sur le corps, il fit un lambeau de toile dont il enveloppa vivement le poignet sanglant de la petite.", "sha256": "0a4087b7027a4d761f16d13ffacef7bb648ed1489cc778c6b46b89d2e6edac1c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0070", "tag": "display_group", "text": "Cela fait, son œil s’abaissa sur la chemise déchirée avec\nsatisfaction.", "sha256": "29fcd73f07b4ceff757274ed2dc75521f6a15f19763618c8fc24e4da1203e163", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_lines": ["Cela fait, son œil s’abaissa sur la chemise déchirée avec", "satisfaction."]}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0071", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et la chemise aussi, dit-il. Tout cela a bon air.", "sha256": "995d33c9bc74bc337037efa4b8fa64c15ff3046e74908b7039adf1a7d1a91700", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0072", "tag": "prose", "text": "Une bise glacée sifflait à la vitre et entrait dans la chambre. La brume du dehors y pénétrait et s’y dilatait comme une ouate blanchâtre vaguement démêlée par des doigts invisibles. À travers le carreau cassé, on voyait tomber la neige. Le froid promis la veille par le soleil de la Chandeleur était en effet venu.", "sha256": "135c0cb58f6baf0590c3afcd316113bcd0d0b3fe6d2c9f1ff0da76dc8820d8b9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0073", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le père promena un coup d’œil autour de lui comme pour s’assurer qu’il n’avait rien oublié. Il prit une vieille pelle et répandit de la cendre sur les tisons mouillés de façon à les cacher complètement.", "sha256": "d9570c698ce4e040663b94a396fb0a40d07cd15f105ed9de1c5ed4d814334507", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0074", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis se relevant et s’adossant à la cheminée :", "sha256": "2fdb68133e727a40a042f2aec21dbbc811911cc69b5bf800898e39997602420d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0075", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Maintenant, dit-il, nous pouvons recevoir le philanthrope.", "sha256": "deb5a2812960b2d5cab067655fcd97be864e2d88e55ec7c55db1365d53ab95b8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
